desc: This ultra-steady shooting bench offers a stable, comfortable, and spacious shooting surface for target practice or field hunting. The 21 wide x 28 long padded bench top provides comfort and a non-scratch surface protecting your gun, while also providing two additional gear pouches for ammunition or accessories. The gun rest is versatile to accommodate ambidextrous shooters and is adjustable to any position desired; also coated in durable non-scratch rubber. 12 wide x 14 deep x 1 thick seat folds up. Folds flat for space saving storage and easy transport. The bench as a whole weighs a mere 32lbs.with a weight limit of 300 lbs.
